title: dibs config
description: ~/.dibs/config.json (global) or a project's .dibs/config.json. Project overrides global; DIBS_* env overrides both.

id.description: Project id, written by dibs. Links this project to its record in ~/.dibs/projects/projects.jsonl; don't edit.

scope.description: Where todos live: in the project (.dibs), in ~/.dibs/projects, or a temporary per-session file. Set per project with /todos scope.

file.description: Explicit todos file path; ~ is expanded. Overridden by DIBS_FILE.

adapters.description: Sync dibs todos with other task apps.

dex.description: Removed adapter. Disable sync and use dibs init --from=dex instead.
